info.title: UnoStudio
info.description: Command-line client for Uno Studio. Builds an application the way Studio builds it - headlessly, on your own machine or CI runner - and composes a shareable link to the result. Also configures a stock Git client to work with Studio Projects using the Uno Platform license already installed on the machine. Includes MCP server mode.
